memo: Helped: changing compute per step. Smaller model (DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=85) gave 1.1033 (-0.0112). Cutting TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**17 gave 1.0506/1.0488 (-0.0536), the biggest win. The incumbent is now mean 1.0497 over 2 runs. Flagged tripwire on slot 10, so check that result. Did not help: bigger model (DEPTH=10, +0.0618), SwiGLU, HEAD_DIM 64, EMBEDDING_LR 0.4, Adam beta 0.99, warmup, WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.7 or 0.3, weight decay 0.05 or 0.1, logit softcap 8, grad clipping. All are within about +0.005 of the incumbent, so they look like noise or slightly worse. Embedding init 0.5 gave -0.0019 before the batch change, so retest it. Next: go further on batch size (2**16, since smaller steps helped), then DEPTH 5 or 4 with the small batch. Retune LR for the small batch, including EMBEDDING_LR above 0.6. Replicate any accepted change, because noise looks like about 0.002.
